top_issues.issue: Hyphens render with wide side gaps across the app ('On - call', 'Sign - in', 'Ad - hoc', 'go/no - go', 'Step - by - step', 'F4KQ - 9TZW', 'open - source').
top_issues.evidence: 4x zoom of chats.png (125,110)-(250,150) and signin-failed.png title: about 4 px blank each side of the hyphen at 13-18 pt, vs about 1 px in normal Inter kerning.
top_issues.fix: Render U+2011 as U+002D (or map it in the font fallback), and stop text transforms from inserting non-breaking hyphens. Check the glyph advance width matches Inter's hyphen (about 0.33 em).

top_issues.issue: At 1920 wide the conversation column is capped at about 920 px and left-aligned, leaving a ~600 px dead band. Header actions stop at x≈1290 while the header rule runs to 1920.
top_issues.evidence: Messages, composer and header icons end at x≈1300 in chats-wide.png. x 1300-1920 is empty background.
top_issues.fix: Center the capped column in the pane (or cap at ~1040 px and center it), and align the header action cluster to the same column edge. Alternatively let the column grow to 100% with a 72-ch max line length for message text only.

top_issues.issue: Error toast is placed over the conversation's top message and covers its text. It also repeats the inline failure without its own action.
top_issues.evidence: Toast at (576,64)-(1068,111) covers 'Can we ship the 0.2 preview on Friday?' at y≈110.
top_issues.fix: Anchor toasts bottom-right above the composer (16 pt from edges), or as a full-width 32 pt banner under the header that pushes content down. Add a 'Retry' text button in the toast, or drop the toast when the inline 'Not sent · Retry' is visible.

top_issues.issue: The orange left bar marks the selected row in Chat/Teams lists but appears on every Calendar row. Calendar selection is only a fill with 1.17:1 against the list.
top_issues.evidence: Light: selected fill #E4E4E8 vs list #F6F6F7 = 1.17:1. Every row has an #A9530F 3 px bar.
top_issues.fix: Use a 6 px coloured dot or a neutral category bar in Calendar rows, and reserve the 3 px accent bar for selection, as in Chat. Or keep the bars and add a 1 px #A9530F outline to the selected row.

top_issues.issue: Mixed button language: filled pills with almost no boundary (Copy link, call bar buttons, theme segment) sit next to 6 px-radius outlined buttons (Reply, Cancel, Leave demo). Pill buttons fail 3:1 for component boundaries.
top_issues.evidence: Copy link #EEEEF0 on #FFFFFF 1.16:1 (dark #2C2D33/#17181B 1.29:1). Call bar pills #EEEEF0 on #F6F6F7 1.07:1 (dark 1.21:1). Unselected theme pills 1.16:1 / 1.10:1. Outlined buttons use #8A8D95 at 3.32:1.
top_issues.fix: Use one secondary-button style app-wide: 6 px radius, 1 px #8A8D95 border (dark #6E7179), 28 pt height. For segmented controls, add a 1 px #8A8D95 container border with the selected segment filled.

top_issues.issue: At 760 wide the list/tree pane keeps a fixed ~232 px. Names truncate heavily and the conversation wraps at ~400 px.
top_issues.fix: Under ~900 px, shrink the list pane to 200 px and drop the time column to the second line. Or collapse to a 64 px avatar-only list with names on hover. In Calls, show call/video buttons only on hover or focus so names get the width.

top_issues.issue: Long draft composer shows a row of clipped glyphs at its top edge, and the scroll thumb floats left of the attach icon instead of at the right edge.
top_issues.evidence: Descender fragments at y≈553-557. Thumb #767779 (4.48:1) at x≈1178-1184, y≈737-751.
top_issues.fix: Clip the text viewport 8 pt inside the composer border with a 12 pt fade at the top. Put the scrollbar against the right inner edge (x = right − 6 pt) of the text area, above the action row.

top_issues.issue: Paragraph leading is inconsistent and tight: 17 px line pitch on ~14-15 pt text (≈1.15) in sign-in, setup and Calls copy, vs 23 px on the device-code card and ~20 px in messages.
top_issues.evidence: signin.png body lines at y=365, 382, 399. calls.png 'How calls work' lines at 234 and 251. signin-device-code body lines at 370 and 393.
top_issues.fix: Use one body line height of 1.4 (20 pt for 14 pt text, 21 pt for 15 pt) for all multi-line descriptive text. Keep 1.25 only for single-line labels.

top_issues.issue: Inline field and button heights don't match.
top_issues.evidence: Calls: input 125-153 (28 px) vs Join 125-157 (32 px). Setup: inputs 28 px vs Save 32 px.
top_issues.fix: Use one control height of 28 pt for inputs and buttons placed side by side, and align them on the same centre line.

top_issues.issue: Scrolled history shows half-cut avatars and reaction chips under the header with no fade.
top_issues.evidence: chats.png 'AR' avatar visible only y≈40-52 beneath the header rule at y=52. Same in channel.png at y≈45.
top_issues.fix: Add a 16 pt gradient fade from the pane background at the top of the scroll area, or snap the initial scroll so the first visible item starts at a message boundary.

top_issues.issue: Meeting detail is thin and redundant. The right half of the pane is empty.
top_issues.evidence: Card 640 px wide with Location 'Teams' and Online 'Microsoft Teams meeting' both shown. Nothing from x=1028 to 1280.
top_issues.fix: Repeat the title in the card at 18 pt and add attendees (avatars plus count) and the agenda body. Merge Location and Online when they match. Let the card fill the pane to a 720 pt max width.

top_issues.issue: Shortcuts dialog nearly touches the window bottom, and keycap chips have almost invisible edges.
top_issues.evidence: Dialog spans y=90-787 in an 800 px window. Keycap border #DFDFE3 on white 1.33:1 (dark #303137/#25262B 1.16:1).
top_issues.fix: Use two columns (Navigation+App | Messages) or a scroll area with a 48 pt bottom margin. Give keycaps a 1 px #8A8D95 border (dark #6E7179) or a 1 px bottom shadow.

top_issues.issue: System lines in the meeting chat have uneven spacing, and the call bar has no elapsed time.
top_issues.evidence: 'Meeting ended' baseline sits 8 px below the previous message body, but 'Meeting started' has 16 px above.
top_issues.fix: Give system lines 12 pt above and below. Add an elapsed timer ('12:04') after 'In the meeting'. Rename 'Close bar' to 'Hide bar'.

top_issues.issue: The message hover toolbar stays drawn behind modal scrims, so a hover state shows under a dialog.
top_issues.evidence: Toolbar visible at (1020,352)-(1258,390) under the scrim in settings.png and shortcuts.png.
top_issues.fix: Clear the hovered-message state when a modal opens (no pointer hit-test through the scrim).

top_issues.issue: Pending image thumbnails crop without indication, and the remove badges overlap the image.
top_issues.evidence: 3072×256 tile shows a 2-bird crop. × badges at the tile corners cover image pixels. Dark tiles have no 1 px frame.
top_issues.fix: Letterbox (fit) images in 136×96 tiles on a #EEEEF0 / #2C2D33 background with a 1 px border. Place the × badge 4 pt outside the top-right corner on a 20 pt circle with a 2 pt background-coloured ring.

top_issues.issue: Device-code tooltip runs ~245 px past the card edge and covers the App registration row. The sign-in stack is top-heavy.
top_issues.evidence: Tooltip spans x=609-1118, card ends at x=874. Finishing card ends at y=421 in an 800 px window.
top_issues.fix: Cap tooltip width at 320 pt and anchor it to the card. Vertically center the logo+card+footer group (or offset it 40% from the top).

top_issues.issue: Minor state gaps: the empty list column is blank, the status input has no label, and new-chat results don't highlight matches.
top_issues.evidence: first-sync-empty list x 64-364 is blank. Status input shows only the placeholder 'For example: Back at 3 pm'.
top_issues.fix: Add a 13 pt 'No chats yet' line in the list. Add a 12 pt 'Status message' label above the input. Bold the matched substring in result names.
